name: Four-on-the-floor pump
desc: Quarter-note ramp-up swell locked to the beat, 70 % deep: the sidechain duck of a kick, without a kick

refs.why: the whole track pumps against the kick like a sidechain duck

notes: Ramp Up drops at each beat and swells back, depth in dB so it sounds even; works on pads, bass, or a whole guitar bus
